records.narration_anchor: In 1812 Napoleon marched into Russia with a vast army.
records.visual_concept: Napoleon in front of map of Europe and marching columns

records.narration_anchor: Months later his army was shattered.
records.visual_concept: Exhausted retreating soldiers on a broken road

records.narration_anchor: But the disaster was not caused by winter alone.
records.visual_concept: Two-season contrast: summer logistic strain, later snow
